title: tests/test_daily_dd_switch.py::test_prop_risk_manager_carries_quiescent_reading is clock-dependent: fails every day 22:30Z-00:30Z (CI red on main and every PR in that window)
note: 2026-10-10 22:58Z manager: reproduced on origin/main at 22:55Z (assert 'ok' == 'carried_quiescent'). Cause: breakout_2 daily_loss_reset_utc 00:30Z; daily_dd_switch counts a reading within CARRY_DAY_START_WINDOW (2h) before the day boundary as today's, so the test's monkeypatched reading 'now - 1 day' reads OK, not carried, between 22:30Z and 00:30Z. Fix (one line): use timedelta(days=2) in the monkeypatched prop_equity_reading (now-2d is always before boundary-2h). The manager's edit was refused by the auto-mode classifier ('Security Test Removal'); per the operator's rule it was not worked around. Needs the operator to approve the edit, or to run it with auto mode off.
